_readme: This is the fallback/manual path only — if you've set up the Google Apps Script + Gemini pipeline (see google-apps-script/Code.gs and the README), the live 'AI Analysis' sheet tab is used instead and this file is only consulted when that isn't reachable. Rename this file to ai-analysis.json (and remove this _readme key) to enable it manually. Keyed by the Google Sheet row number (as text). Each entry supplies the fields that Column AF/AH/AI PDF analysis produces, since app.js cannot read PDFs or call an AI model at runtime on its own — see README.md, section 'AI-analyzed fields'. This example uses a fictional row/petitioner only; do not commit real petitioner data (names, Aadhaar, mobile, PDF links) to a public repository.

2.petitionerRequestSummary: Example: original PGRS application filed <date> requesting <relief> for Survey No. <x> in <village>, enclosing Aadhaar copy, 1-B extract and Adangal record.
2.fieldEnquiryReport: Example: field enquiry on <date> confirmed the petitioner's possession of the land in question; no encroachment found; measurements match the FMB sketch.
2.personsAttended: Example: Village Revenue Officer, Village Surveyor, Petitioner
2.remarksTahsildar: Example: recommended for mutation based on field enquiry findings.
